recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Future changes to replace or revise the signature extension should be handled as a new work-group decision, likely in the Extension Pack or SDC rather than as a core QuestionnaireResponse element.
issue_request: FHIR-16045 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core request to add a Signature datatype element to QuestionnaireResponse for inline legal signatures; the final resolution says it was addressed as part of FHIR-16044 by adding extensions.
initial_application: SVN #14772, represented by git commit b8c5990ac5, added a QuestionnaireResponse signature extension row with contexts QuestionnaireResponse, QuestionnaireResponse.item, and QuestionnaireResponse.item.item and value type Signature.
additional_context: FHIR-16044 is the parent issue defining the paired Questionnaire signature-required and QuestionnaireResponse signature extensions. Core later moved standard extension definitions out of the R5 source, while the current FHIR Extension Pack contains questionnaireresponse-signature and core still references the extension from the Signature datatype page and OID registry. Later Zulip discussion uses the extension and records no final replacement decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding QuestionnaireResponse.signature as a core element would contradict the modified resolution; the current extension-based state is already correct.
